boardQueries.query: SELECT s.id, s.as_of, s.entries FROM leaderboard_snapshot s WHERE s.id = COALESCE( (SELECT r.snapshot_id FROM weekly_campaign_run r WHERE r.iso_week = $1 AND r.state IN ($3, $4)),
